docs.title: 13.5.3 stream/chat ​与​事件​归一
docs.text:
stream()（client.py:859）​是​同步​生成器​，​产出​ StreamEvent （client.py:135）：

StreamEventType = Literal["values", "messages-tuple", "custom", "end"]

@dataclass
class StreamEvent:
    """A single event from the streaming agent response.

    Event types align with the LangGraph SSE protocol:
        - ``"values"``: State snapshot (title, messages, artifacts, summary_text).
        - ``"messages-tuple"``: Per-message update (AI text, tool calls, tool results).
        - ``"end"``: Stream finished.
    """

​事件​类型​与​ SSE ​协议​对齐​——​消费者​可以​在​ HTTP ​流式​与​内嵌​模式​之间​切换​而​不​改​事件​ ​处理​逻辑​（_stream_turn ​的​ docstring ​明确​了​这​一​契约​）。token ​级​细节​： messages-tuple ​对​ AI ​文本​以​ delta ​形式​发出​，​每​条带​稳定​ id。 stream() ​还有​两个​值得注意​的​实现​细节​（client.py:877-899）：trace id ​只​在​每次​ next() ​步骤​周围​绑定​（sync generator ​与​调用者​共享​上下文​，​跨​ yield ​绑定​会​泄漏​ ContextVar）；generator ​被​放弃​时​ close() ​仍会​在​绑定​ id ​下​完成​日志​与​回调​清理​。

chat()（client.py:1314）​是​便捷​封装​：

    def chat(self, message: str, *, thread_id: str | None = None, **kwargs) -> str:
        """Send a message and return the final text response.

        Convenience wrapper around :meth:`stream` that accumulates delta
        ``messages-tuple`` events per ``id`` and returns the text of the
        **last** AI message to complete.  Intermediate AI messages (e.g.
        planner drafts) are discarded — only the final id's accumulated
        text is returned.
        """

​累加​规则​由​ _AIMessageAccumulator（client.py:153）​实现​：​按​消息​ id ​分桶​拼接​， "metadata-only ​更新​不选新​ id"，​最后​取​最后​一个​ content-bearing AI ​消息​ id ​的​全文​。 ​无头​ CLI ​也​用​同一​规则​挑​最终​答案​。

docs.title: 13.5.4 ​上传​与​产物​回收
docs.text:
upload_files()（client.py:1754）​与​ Gateway POST /uploads ​行为​对齐​：

  • ​先​整批​验证​再​落盘​（"Validate all files upfront to avoid partial uploads"）： ​不​存在​抛​ FileNotFoundError，​非​普通​文件​、​不​安全​或​保留​名​（.upload-*.part） ​抛​ ValueError；​同批​重复​名​走​ claim_unique_filename ​的​ _N ​后缀​逻辑​；
  • PDF/PPT/Excel/Word ​转​ Markdown（​转换​ worker ​复用​，​已​在​事件​循环​内时​不​新建​线程​池​）；
  • ​返回​结构​匹配​ Gateway UploadResponse schema（​含​ skipped_files）—— ​目标​名是​符号​链接​或​其他​非常规​文件​时​跳​过​并列​出​，​绝不​经​符号​链接​写入​。

get_artifact()（client.py:1973）​回收​产物​：

    def get_artifact(self, thread_id: str, path: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
        """Read an artifact file produced by the agent.

        Args:
            path: Virtual path (e.g. "mnt/user-data/outputs/file.txt").

        Returns:
            Tuple of (file_bytes, mime_type).
        """
        validate_thread_id(thread_id)
        try:
            actual = get_paths().resolve_virtual_path(thread_id, path, user_id=get_effective_user_id())
        except ValueError as exc:
            if "traversal" in str(exc):
                from deerflow.uploads.manager import PathTraversalError

                raise PathTraversalError("Path traversal detected") from exc
            raise

​入​参是​虚拟​路径​（mnt/user-data/outputs/...），​解析​到​真实​线程​目录​，​路径​穿越​ ​显式​转成​ PathTraversalError——​与​ Gateway artifacts ​路由​同​一套​ get_paths() ​解析器​。

​其余​常用​方法​：list_models()（client.py:1342，​返回​结构​对齐​ Gateway ModelsListResponse）、list_skills()（client.py:1369）、get_memory() / import_memory()（client.py:1393、1409）、list_threads()（client.py:762）。

docs.title: 动手​实验
docs.text:
​写​一个​ Python ​脚本​，​用​ DeerFlowClient ​完成​"​上传​ CSV → ​让​ agent ​生成​图表​脚本​ ​并​产出​结果​文件​ → ​回收​产物​"​的​完整​闭环​。​在​ backend/ ​目录​下​运行​（​依赖​已​由​ make install ​装​好​）：

# run_embedded.py -- ​放在​ backend/ ​目录​外​任意​位置​，​或​ backend/ ​下均​可​
from pathlib import Path

from deerflow.client import DeerFlowClient
from langgraph.checkpoint.memory import MemorySaver

# 1) ​构造​客户端​：MemorySaver ​提供​多轮​上下文​（​生产​可换​ SqliteSaver）
client = DeerFlowClient(
    thinking_enabled=True,
    plan_mode=True,          # ​观察​第​ 11 ​章​的​ write_todos
    checkpointer=MemorySaver(),
)

thread_id = "tutorial-embedded-run"

# 2) ​上传​本地​ CSV（​自动​获得​ _N ​后缀​与​可选​ Markdown ​转换​）
csv_path = Path("sample.csv")          # ​自备​一个​小​ CSV
result = client.upload_files(thread_id, [csv_path])
print(result["message"])
virtual = result["files"][0]["virtual_path"]   # /mnt/user-data/uploads/sample.csv

# 3) ​流式​驱动​一次​ run
events = []
for event in client.stream(
    f"​请​用​ Python ​分析​ {virtual}，​把​统计​摘要​写​进​ outputs/summary.txt ​并​画​一张​分布图​",
    thread_id=thread_id,
):
    events.append(event)
    if event.type == "messages-tuple" and event.data.get("type") == "ai":
        print(event.data.get("content", ""), end="", flush=True)
print()

# 4) ​产物​回收​：​按​虚拟​路径​读取​ outputs ​下​的​文件​
for artifact in ("mnt/user-data/outputs/summary.txt",):
    try:
        data, mime = client.get_artifact(thread_id, artifact)
        print(f"\n--- {artifact} ({mime}, {len(data)} bytes) ---")
        print(data.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:500])
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"\n{artifact} ​不​存在​（agent ​未​产出​）")

# 5) ​配置​查询​（​与​ Gateway API ​同构​）
print(client.list_models()["models"][0]["name"])
print(len(client.list_skills()["skills"]))

​观察点​：

  1. events ​里​ values ​事件​的​ summary_text ​是否​为空​（​短​对话​不​触发​摘要​）， artifacts ​字​段​是否​随​ run ​更新​；
  2. ​打开​ backend/.deer-flow/threads/tutorial-embedded-run/user-data/uploads/， ​对照​上传​响应​里​的​ path / virtual_path / artifact_url ​三套​路径​；
  3. ​把​ checkpointer ​去掉​再​跑​一次​——​第二轮​对话​ agent ​不再​记得​第一轮​，​验证​ client.py:184 ​的​"​无​ checkpointer ​即​无​状态​"；
  4. ​想​走​ HTTP ​路径​对照​？​用​同一​ prompt ​打​ POST http://localhost:2026/api/langgraph/runs/stream（​先​ curl ​上传​文件​到​ /api/threads/{thread_id}/uploads），​从​ Content-Location ​头取​ thread_id， ​事件​形状​与​ StreamEvent ​一一对应​。

docs.title: 常见​坑
docs.text:
1. ​多轮​对话​没​传​ checkpointer——​每次​ chat() ​都​是​全新​会话​（thread_id ​只​隔离​ ​文件​）。​嵌入式​用法​必须​自己​提供​ checkpointer；Gateway ​路径​则​由​ database: ​配置​ ​自动​装配​，​两者​行为​差异​常让​从​ HTTP ​切​到​内嵌​的​开发者​困惑​。
  2. ​内嵌​客户端​配置​"​不​生效​"——agent ​在​首次​调用​时​构建​并​按​配置​键​缓存​；​运行​中途​ ​改了​ config.yaml / ​装​了​新技能​后​，​长驻​进程​要​显式​ reset_agent()（client.py:282）。
  3. PAT ​调​ uploads ​返回​ 403——PAT ​是​路由​级​默认​拒绝​加​ scope ​双重​约束​， uploads/memory/MCP ​配置​等​不​在​ allowlist ​里​（API.md:140-156）。​上传​文件​请​用​ session cookie ​或​内嵌​客户端​，PAT ​只管​ thread/run ​生命周期​。
  4. ​直连​ 8001 ​端口​绕过​ nginx——​功能​上​多数​可用​，​但会​丢失​ /api/langgraph ​重写​ ​之外​的​代理​语义​（20M body、600s ​超时​、WebSocket ​升级​头​），​且​违背​回环​默认​绑定​ ​的​部署​模型​。​编程​接入​请​走​ http://localhost:2026。
  5. ​自己​改​ nginx ​把​ browser/stream ​正则​挪到​后面​——WebSocket ​静默​降级​，​前端​ Live ​流​失效​；backend/tests/test_nginx_browser_websocket.py ​会​拦住​这​类​改动​， CI ​红​了​先​检查​ location ​顺序​。
  6. ​给​ run ​传​不​支持​的​选项​期待​静默​忽略​——DeerFlow ​对​不​支持​的​ stream_mode、 webhook、after_seconds、​未声明​ SDK ​选项​一律​ 422（API.md:347-357）。 ​这是​"​显式​失败​优于​静默​偏离​"​的​设计​，​写​ SDK ​封装​时要​把​ 422 ​当作​参数​错误​而​不是​ ​服务端​故障​。
  7. thread_data_mounts: true ​设错​环境​——Gateway ​与​沙箱​没有​真​挂载​同​一份​ user-data ​时​，​上传​文件​在​沙箱​内​不​可见​且​不​报错​。​拿不准​就​省略​，​保留​自动检测​ （FILE_UPLOAD.md ​上传​流程​节​）。

docs.title: 下​一步
docs.text: ​你​已经​能​从​任何​ Python ​程序​、​任何​ LangGraph SDK ​客户端​驱动​ DeerFlow。​接下来​是​ "​改它​"：harness ​与​ app ​的​分层​边界​、TDD ​门禁​、​版本​锁步​——​动手​改​核心​之前​必读​的​ ​工程​规范​，​见​第三篇​《​第​ 14 ​章​ ​架构​分层​与​开发​规范​（​二次开发​前​必读​）》 （docs/TUTORIAL_OUTLINE.md ​第​ 14 ​章​小节​）。

docs.title: 第​ 14 ​章​ ​架构​分层​与​开发​规范​（​二次开发​前​必读​）
docs.text: ​精通​篇​从​本章​开始​。​前​两篇​你​一直​在​"​用​"DeerFlow；​从​本章​起​你​要​"​改​"​它​。​改​代码​之前​ ​必须​先​回答​三个​问题​：​代码​分​几层​、​依赖​朝​哪边​流​、CI ​用​什么​门禁​拦住​违规​改动​。 ​本章​用​真实​源码​回答​：Harness/App ​两条​层​的​单向​依赖​（CI ​强制​）、​第三层​契约​包​ deerflow-extension-api、TDD/​分片​测试​/Alembic ​迁移​的​工程​规范​，​以及​包根​懒​加载​ ​的​导入​纪律​。​读完​再​动手​，​你会少​踩​ 90% ​的​"​改​一行​、CI ​全红​"​的​坑​。

docs.title: 本章​源码​锚点
docs.text: 主题​ ​锚点​ ​分层​总览​ docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3、backend/AGENTS.md（Harness / App Split ​节​） ​边界​ CI ​门禁​ backend/tests/test_harness_boundary.py（47 ​行​，​精读​） ​契约​包​ backend/packages/extension-api/deerflow_extension_api/__init__.py ​契约​包元​数据​ backend/packages/extension-api/pyproject.toml Harness ​包元​数据​ backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml App ​包元​数据​ / uv workspace backend/pyproject.toml ​懒​加载​包根​ ① backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/__init__.py ​懒​加载​包根​ ② backend/packages/harness/deerflow/subagents/__init__.py ​后​端​命令​ backend/Makefile ​测试​布局​ backend/tests/（​约​ 1340 ​个​文件​）+ backend/tests/conftest.py ​迁移​示例​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/migrations/versions/0047_mcp_oauth_tokens.py ​导入​约定​（​权威​） backend/AGENTS.md "Import conventions" ​与​ "Package import hygiene" ​节

docs.title: 14.0 ​学习​目标
docs.text:
​读完​本章​，​你​应该​能够​：

  1. ​画出​后​端​三层​结构​（app.* → deerflow.* ← deerflow_extension_api.*）​并​解释​ ​每​一层​的​发布​属性​：​谁​是​可​发布​框架​、​谁​是​ unpublished ​应用​、​谁​是​宿主​无关​契约​；
  2. ​说​清​ test_harness_boundary.py ​如何​用​ AST ​扫描​在​ CI ​里​强制​"Harness ​永不​ import app"，​以及​违规​ import ​长​什么样​、​报错​长​什么样​；
  3. ​遵守​工程​规范​跑通​一个​完整​后​端​改动​闭环​：TDD ​写​测试​ → make test ​四分​片​ → make test-blocking-io Blockbuster ​门禁​ → make migrate-rev ​生成​迁移​；
  4. ​解释​ deerflow.agents / deerflow.subagents ​包根​为什么​必须​懒​加载​，​写出​ "​轻量​导入​"​风格​的​内部​模块​ import；
  5. ​独立​完成​一次​"harness ​内​定位​一处​中间件​ + ​跑​绿​全部​门禁​"​的​演练​（​动手​实验​）。

docs.title: 14.1 ​概念​讲解​：​三层​结构​与​依赖​方向
14.1.1 ​两层​主干​ + ​一层​契约
docs.text:
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §3 ​给出​主干​规则​：

Harness（backend/packages/harness/deerflow/，import ​前缀​ deerflow.*）—— ​可​发布​的​ agent ​框架​：​编排​、​工具​、​沙箱​、​模型​、MCP、​技能​、​记忆​、​配置​，​即​"​构建​和​ ​运行​ agent ​所​需​的​一切​"。 App（backend/app/，import ​前缀​ app.*）——unpublished ​应用​代码​：FastAPI Gateway ​与​ IM ​渠道​集成​。

​在​这​两层​之间​还有​一个​"​第三层​"：deerflow-extension-api （backend/packages/extension-api/），​它​定义​与​宿主​无关​的​扩展​契约​。​三者​的​依赖​ ​关系​是​严格​单向​的​：

        app.*  ──import──▶  deerflow.*  ◀──import──  ​扩展​(extension)​代码​
          │                     ▲                        │
          └──import──▶ deerflow_extension_api ◀──import──┘
                    （deerflow ​宿主​实现​这份​契约​，
                      ​契约​包​自己​谁​也​不​ import）

​三个​关键​性质​，​每个​都​有​源码​证据​：

  • App ​可以​ import Harness：backend/pyproject.toml:8 ​把​ deerflow-harness ​声明​为​ deer-flow ​的​第一个​运行​时​依赖​。
  • Harness ​永不​ import App：​这是​ CI ​强制​规则​（​下​一节​精读​测试​）。
  • ​契约​包不​ import ​任何人​：backend/packages/extension-api/pyproject.toml:8 ​的​ dependencies = []——​它​连​ deerflow ​都​不​依赖​（14.2 ​节​精读​）。

docs.title: 14.1.2 ​为什么​要​分层
docs.text:
​一句​话​：​框架​要​能​独立​发布​，​应用​才​有​自由​重构​的​权利​。

  • deerflow-harness ​是​ backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:1-4 ​里​一个​ ​正式​的​ PyPI ​风格​包​（name deerflow-harness，version 2.3.0-dev）。​它​可以​被​ ​任何​第三方​项目​ uv add deerflow-harness ​后​单独​用来​构建​ agent——​不​需要​ Gateway、 ​不​需要​ IM ​渠道​。backend/pyproject.toml:114-119 ​把​两个​包​登记​进​ uv workspace：
[tool.uv.workspace]
members = ["packages/harness", "packages/extension-api"]

[tool.uv.sources]
deerflow-harness = { workspace = true }
deerflow-extension-api = { workspace = true }

（backend/pyproject.toml:114-119）workspace ​内​源码​引用​让​ monorepo ​开发​时​ ​三个​包​共享​同​一份​源码​，​发布​时​又​能​各自​独立​出包​。

  • app.* ​里​的​ Gateway ​拼装​了​ FastAPI ​路由​、IM ​渠道​、​调度​器​等​"​部署​形态​"​的​代码​。 ​这​一层​不​发布​。​把​产品​逻辑​写​进​ deerflow.* ​会​让​框架​背上​产品​包袱​；​写​进​ app.* ​又​无法​被​其他​ DeerFlow ​复用​——​所以​有​了​第三层​的​扩展​契约​：​平台​能力​ （​第​ 16 ​章​的​扩展​系统​）​通过​ deerflow_extension_api ​的​稳定​接口​注入​，​实现​ ​代码​住​在​扩展​包​里​，​宿主​与​扩展​可以​分别​演进​。

docs.title: 14.1.3 ​依赖​方向​的​正反​例​（import ​约定​）
docs.text:
backend/AGENTS.md "Import conventions" ​节​（backend/AGENTS.md:159-173）​给出​ ​权威​示例​，​逐条​对照​源码​：

​正确​写法​ ①：Harness ​内部​互相​引用​

# Harness internal
from deerflow.agents import make_lead_agent
from deerflow.models import create_chat_model

​正确​写法​ ②：App ​内部​互相​引用​

# App internal
from app.gateway.app import app
from app.channels.service import start_channel_service

​正确​写法​ ③：App → Harness（​唯一​允许​的​跨层​方向​）

# App → Harness (allowed)
from deerflow.config import get_app_config

​真实​例子​随手​可​查​：Gateway ​的​服务​层取​配置​就是​这​条​路径​（​第​ 13 ​章里​ start_run ​读​ get_app_config() ​即属​此类​）。

​错误​写法​：Harness → App（CI ​直接​拒绝​）

# Harness → App (FORBIDDEN — enforced by test_harness_boundary.py)
# from app.gateway.routers.uploads import ...  # ← will fail CI

​假设​你​想​在​ harness ​的​某个​工具​里​"​顺手​"​调​ Gateway ​的​上传​路由​——​这个​ import ​一旦​ ​落盘​，make test（​本地​）​与​ CI（​远端​）​都​会​在​ test_harness_boundary.py ​失败​， ​报错​信息​会​把​违规​文件​与​行号​列出来​（​见​下​一节​摘录​）。​正确​的​改法​是​把​需要​的​能力​ ​抽象​成​ harness ​内​的​接口​，​或​走​扩展​契约​注入​（​第​ 16 ​章​）。

​还有​一条​容易​被​忽略​的​反向​纪律​：​契约​包不​ import ​宿主​。deerflow_extension_api ​的​模块​里​找​不到​任何​ from deerflow...——​如果​扩展​作者​在​契约​层​"​借​"​了​宿主​的​实现​， ​契约​包​的​独立性​就​名存实亡​。

docs.title: 14.2 ​源码​走读​：​边界​如何​被​ CI ​强制
14.2.1 ​精读​ test_harness_boundary.py
docs.text:
​整个​测试​只有​ 47 ​行​，​没有​ mock、​没有​网络​、​没有​ fixture——​它​就是​一次​纯​静态​的​ AST ​扫描​。​先看​扫描​范围​与​禁用​前缀​（backend/tests/test_harness_boundary.py:13-16）：

HARNESS_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "packages" / "harness" / "deerflow"

BANNED_PREFIXES = ("app.",)

HARNESS_ROOT ​从​测试​文件​位置​反​推出​ packages/harness/deerflow，​即​ Harness ​层​ ​的​完整​源码​树​；BANNED_PREFIXES ​目前​只有​一个​成员​ "app."。​注意​元组​的​设计​： ​未来​若​出现​新​的​禁用​方向​（​比如​禁止​契约​包​ import ​宿主​），​加​一个​前缀​即可​。

​收集​ import ​的​函数​把​源码​解析​成​ AST，​遍历​两种​节点​（backend/tests/test_harness_boundary.py:18-34）：

def _collect_imports(filepath: Path) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
    """Return (line_number, module_path) for every import in *filepath*."""
    source = filepath.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(source, filename=str(filepath))
    except SyntaxError:
        return []

    results: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
            for alias in node.names:
                results.append((node.lineno, alias.name))
        elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
            if node.module:
                results.append((node.lineno, node.module))
    return results

​三个​细节​值得​学​：

  1. ast.parse ​而​不是​正则​——from app import x、import app.gateway、 ​字符串​拼接​的​动态​ import（importlib.import_module("app.x") ​除外​）​都​能​被​ ​语法​层面​覆盖​，​注释​里​的​假​ import ​不会​误报​；
  2. ​同时​覆盖​ ast.Import ​与​ ast.ImportFrom——import app.gateway.routers ​和​ from app.gateway.routers import x ​是​两种​不同​的​ AST ​节点​；
  3. SyntaxError ​静默​跳过​——​边界​测试​不​为​语法错误​负责​，​那​是​ ruff ​的​职责​， ​分层​测试​保持​单一​职责​。

​断言​本体​在​ backend/tests/test_harness_boundary.py:37-46：

def test_harness_does_not_import_app():
    violations: list[str] = []

    for py_file in sorted(HARNESS_ROOT.rglob("*.py")):
        for lineno, module in _collect_imports(py_file):
            if any(module == prefix.rstrip(".") or module.startswith(prefix) for prefix in BANNED_PREFIXES):
                rel = py_file.relative_to(HARNESS_ROOT.parent.parent.parent)
                violations.append(f"  {rel}:{lineno}  imports {module}")

    assert not violations, "Harness layer must not import from app layer:\n" + "\n".join(violations)
  • rglob("*.py") ​扫​到​ Harness ​的​每​一个​ Python ​文件​（​包括​子包​），sorted() ​保证​报错​顺序​稳定​、diff ​可​读​；
  • ​匹配​规则​是​ module == prefix.rstrip(".") or module.startswith(prefix)—— ​两个​分支​分别​捕获​ import app（​裸​模块​名​，module == "app"）​与​ import app.gateway.routers（​子​模块​，startswith("app.")）​两种​形态​， ​都​拦​；
  • ​失败​消息​逐行​列出​ ​相对路径​:​行号​ imports ​模块​，​你​ push ​之后​在​ CI ​日志​里​ ​能​直接​定位​到行​。

​注意​这个​测试​跑​在​ backend/tests/ ​里​，​属于​四分​片​离线​套件​的​一员​——​它​不​需要​ ​任何​运行​时​环境​，​几​毫秒​完成​。​边界​是​"​测试​"​而​不是​ lint ​插件​是​有意​为​之​： ruff ​的​规则​是​风格​约束​，​这个​测试​是​架构​约束​，​放在​ pytest ​里​意味着​它​和​功能​ ​测试​一起​跑​，​绕​不​过去​。

docs.title: 14.2.2 ​第三层​契约​包​：deerflow-extension-api
docs.text:
​打开​ backend/packages/extension-api/deerflow_extension_api/__init__.py:1-6， ​包级​ docstring ​把​规则​写​在​第一行​：

"""Public contracts for DeerFlow extensions.

This package MUST NOT import `deerflow`. Every host contract an extension
needs lives here, while framework imports remain direct extension dependencies;
extensions can therefore be released independently of the host.
"""

"This package MUST NOT import deerflow" —— ​契约​包​的​独立性​是​文档​声明​的​ ​不​变量​（​第​ 14.1.3 ​节​的​"​反向​纪律​"）。​文件​随后​用​ 100 ​余行​ re-export ​列出​全部​ ​公开​契约​（backend/packages/extension-api/deerflow_extension_api/__init__.py:10-101）： ExtensionRegistry / ExtensionService / MiddlewareContributor / TaskLifecycleContributor / SystemModelRequest…… ​这些​名字​是​第​ 16 ​章​扩展​ ​开发​时​的​完整​词汇表​。​版本号​管理​在​第​ 103-105 ​行​：

#: Contract version. Before 1.0, minors may break and patches are additive.
#: From 1.0 on, bump the major for breaking changes.
API_VERSION = "0.2.11"

1.0 ​之前​ minor ​可​破坏​、patch ​只​做​增量​——​宿主​与​扩展​的​兼容性​由此​协商​。 Harness ​侧​对​这份​契约​用​精确​ pin（backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:12-16）：

# Exact pin by design (extension-system version contract): the host pins
# the contract version it implements, extensions declare ranges. A range
# here would let pip resolve a newer contract package than this harness
# implements, making newer extensions look supported at runtime.
"deerflow-extension-api==0.2.11",

​注释​解释​了​ pin ​的​理由​：​宿主​钉死​它​实现​的​契约​版本​，​扩展​声明​范围​。​如果​宿主​ ​声明​范围​，pip ​可能​解析​出比​宿主​实现​更新​的​契约​包​，​让​"​新​扩展​"​在​运行​时才​炸出​ "​宿主​不​认识​这个​接口​"。

​契约​包​自身​的​ backend/packages/extension-api/pyproject.toml:6-8 ​则​用空​依赖​ ​兑现​了​ docstring ​的​承诺​：

# Keep the contract package import-light and independent from the host. Public
# values are stdlib-based; concrete middleware types are validated by DeerFlow.
dependencies = []

​零​依赖​意味着​"import ​这个​包​不会​有​任何​传递​安装​"，​扩展​作者​可以​放心​把​它​作为​ ​自己​包​的​轻量​依赖​。

App ​层​对​契约​包​也​显式​声明​依赖​，backend/pyproject.toml:9-15 ​的​注释​同样​值得​ ​精读​（​这​是​本​仓库​注释​文化​的​代表​）：

    # Direct dependency on purpose, even though deerflow-harness already pulls
    # it in: app/gateway/app.py and app/gateway/services.py import the public
    # contract package themselves (the extension principal resolver, and the
    # provenance key set the state route strips). Those are the app layer's own
    # imports of a package whose whole point is a stable public surface, so the
    # app declares them rather than relying on the harness to keep supplying it.
    "deerflow-extension-api",

"​自己​ import ​的​包​自己​声明​，​而​不是​搭​ Harness ​传递​依赖​的​便​车​"——​否则​哪​天​ Harness ​内部​不再​ import ​契约​包​，App ​会​无声​地​丢​依赖​。

docs.title: 14.2.3 ​版本​锁步
docs.text: ​三个​包​的​版本​由​仓库​级​约定​锁步​（​根​ AGENTS.md "Version lockstep" ​节​）： backend/pyproject.toml:3（2.3.0-dev）、backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml:3 （2.3.0-dev）、frontend/package.json ​的​ version ​字​段​（2.3.0-dev）、 deploy/helm/deer-flow/Chart.yaml ​的​ version/appVersion（​均​为​ 2.3.0-dev）​四处​必须​一致​，backend/uv.lock ​必须​同步​。​改​版本​统一​用​ scripts/bump_version.sh <ver>，v* tag ​的​ CI ​会​跑​ scripts/verify_versions.sh ​阻断​漂移​。​手改​其中​一处​版本号​是​新人​最​常见​的​ CI ​红灯​来源​之一​。

docs.title: 14.3.1 ​问题​：​包根​ import ​会​引爆​依赖图
docs.text:
deerflow.agents ​和​ deerflow.subagents ​是​ Harness ​里​两个​"​重灾区​"： agents ​包根​连接​着​ lead agent ​的​整张​工具​图​（​进而​拖​出​沙箱​、MCP、​技能​……）， subagents ​包根​连接​着子​代理​执行器​。​如果​包根​ __init__.py ​把​它们​ eager import， ​那么​任何​"​只想读​一个​轻量​类型​"​的​模块​（​例如​运行​时​配置​类​）​都​会​连锁​拉​起​整张​依赖图​。 backend/AGENTS.md "Package import hygiene" ​节​ （backend/AGENTS.md:175-183）​总结​了​这条​纪律​：

the deerflow.agents and deerflow.subagents package roots expose heavyweight graph/executor entrypoints lazily. The deerflow.agents:make_lead_agent LangGraph Server entrypoint is a concrete thin module-level function because the server resolves graph factories directly from the module dictionary; the wrapper keeps the lead-agent and skill-cache imports inside the function so importing the package remains lightweight. Internal modules that only need lightweight types, config, or registries should import the concrete submodule instead of adding eager package-root imports that pull in the tool graph or subagent executor during state/schema imports.

docs.title: 14.3.2 ​精读​ agents/__init__.py
docs.text:
backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/__init__.py:20-31：

def make_lead_agent(config: "RunnableConfig") -> Any:
    """Build the lead graph while keeping package-root imports lightweight.

    LangGraph Server resolves configured graph factories directly from a
    module's ``__dict__``, so this entrypoint must be a concrete module-level
    function rather than a value supplied only through ``__getattr__``.
    """
    from .lead_agent import make_lead_agent as factory
    from .lead_agent.prompt import prime_enabled_skills_cache

    prime_enabled_skills_cache()
    return factory(config)

​两层​设计​意图​：

  1. ​函数​体​内部​ import——lead_agent（​以及​它​拖​出​的​整张​工具​图​）​只​在​真正​ ​构建​ lead agent ​的​那一刻​才​被​加载​；import deerflow.agents ​本身​是​廉价​的​。
  2. ​为什么​不能​全用​ __getattr__ ​懒​加载​——docstring ​写明​：LangGraph Server ​解析​ graph factory ​时​是​直接​查​模块​ __dict__，__getattr__ ​只​在​属性​ ​访问​路径​上​生效​，Server ​的​工厂​查找​不会​触发​它​。​所以​ make_lead_agent ​必须​ ​是​一个​真实​的​模块​级​函数​（​薄壳​），​内部​再​做​懒​ import。​这是​"​懒​加载​纪律​"​与​ "​外部​框架​解析​约定​"​的​折中​，​值得​记住​：​懒​加载​不是​无脑​全懒​，​要​尊重​消费​方​ ​的​发现​机制​。

​其余​重​符号​走​ __getattr__（backend/packages/harness/deerflow/agents/__init__.py:34-50）：

def __getattr__(name: str):
    if name == "create_deerflow_agent":
        from .factory import create_deerflow_agent

        globals()[name] = create_deerflow_agent
        return create_deerflow_agent
    if name in {"DeltaThreadState", "SandboxState", "ThreadState"}:
        from .thread_state import DeltaThreadState, SandboxState, ThreadState

        exports = {
            "DeltaThreadState": DeltaThreadState,
            "SandboxState": SandboxState,
            "ThreadState": ThreadState,
        }
        globals().update(exports)
        return exports[name]
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

​注意​ globals().update(exports) ​这​一行​：​首次​懒​加载​后​把​符号​写回​模块​字典​， ​后续​访问​不再​走​ __getattr__ ​分支​——​一次​付费​，​之后​免费​。

docs.title: 14.3.3 ​精读​ subagents/__init__.py
docs.text:
​同样​的​模式​在​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/subagents/__init__.py:1-12 ​先​给出​一个​反差​：​轻量​符号​是​ eager ​的​——

from .config import SubagentConfig
from .registry import get_available_subagent_names, get_subagent_config, list_subagents

__all__ = [
    "SubagentConfig",
    "SubagentExecutor",
    "SubagentResult",
    "SubagentRuntime",
    "get_available_subagent_names",
    "get_subagent_config",
    "list_subagents",
]

config（Pydantic ​配置​模型​）​和​ registry（​名字​注册表​）​是​轻量​模块​，eager import ​无伤大雅​；__all__ ​里​的​ SubagentExecutor / SubagentResult / SubagentRuntime ​才​是​重量级​，​走​懒​加载​（backend/packages/harness/deerflow/subagents/__init__.py:15-30）：

def __getattr__(name: str):
    if name in {"SubagentExecutor", "SubagentResult"}:
        from .executor import SubagentExecutor, SubagentResult

        exports = {
            "SubagentExecutor": SubagentExecutor,
            "SubagentResult": SubagentResult,
        }
        globals().update(exports)
        return exports[name]
    if name == "SubagentRuntime":
        from .runtime import SubagentRuntime

        globals()[name] = SubagentRuntime
        return SubagentRuntime
    raise AttributeError(f"module {__name__!r} has no attribute {name!r}")

docs.title: 14.3.4 ​写​代码​时​怎么​遵守
docs.text:
• ​内部​模块​只​依赖​轻量​类型​/​配置​/​注册表​时​，​直接​ import ​具体​子​模块​ （from deerflow.subagents.config import SubagentConfig），​不要​通过​包根​ ​拉​执行器​；
  • ​循环​导入​的​自救​：​如果​确实​无法​避免​生产​代码​里​的​循环​链​，​测试​侧​可以​在​ backend/tests/conftest.py ​注入​ sys.modules mock。​仓库​里​现成​的​例子​ （backend/tests/conftest.py:21-40）​把​这​条链​注释​得​一清二楚​：
# Break the circular import chain that exists in production code:
#   deerflow.subagents.__init__
#     -> .executor (SubagentExecutor, SubagentResult)
#       -> deerflow.agents.thread_state
#         -> deerflow.agents.__init__
#           -> lead_agent.agent
#             -> subagent_limit_middleware
#               -> deerflow.subagents.executor  <-- circular!
#
# By injecting a mock for deerflow.subagents.executor *before* any test module
# triggers the import, __init__.py's "from .executor import ..." succeeds
# immediately without running the real executor module.
_executor_mock = MagicMock()
_executor_mock.SubagentExecutor = MagicMock
_executor_mock.SubagentResult = MagicMock
_executor_mock.SubagentStatus = MagicMock
_executor_mock.MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS = 3
_executor_mock.get_background_task_result = MagicMock()

sys.modules["deerflow.subagents.executor"] = _executor_mock

​注意​顺序​：mock ​必须​在​任何​测试​模块​触发​真实​ import ​之前​注入​——conftest ​在​收集​阶段​执行​，​正好​满足​这个​时机​。backend/AGENTS.md:224 ​明确​说​：​轻量​ ​配置​/​工具​模块​遇到​循环​导入​问题​时​，​照​这个​现有​例子​加​ sys.modules mock。

docs.title: 14.4.1 ​测试​目录​全景
docs.text:
backend/tests/ ​约​ 1340 ​个​文件​，​布局​规则​（backend/AGENTS.md TDD ​节​ + ​目录​实况​）：

​位置​ ​内容​ ​运行​方式​ backend/tests/test_<feature>.py ​常规​单元​/​集成​测试​（​默认​离线​） make test ​四分​片​ backend/tests/blocking_io/ Blockbuster ​严格​门禁​套件​（​阻塞​ I/O ​检测​） make test-blocking-io backend/tests/fixtures/、conftest.py、_*.py ​辅助​模块​ ​共享​ fixture ​与​ helper ​被​上述​两者​引用​ ​标记​ live ​的​测试​ ​真实​外部​ API，​需​ DEER_FLOW_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 ​显式​开启​ make test-live

backend/pyproject.toml:86-92 ​用​ pytest markers ​固化​了​这套​语言​：

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
markers = [
    "no_auto_user: disable the conftest autouse contextvar fixture for this test",
    "allow_blocking_io: opt out of the strict Blockbuster gate in tests/blocking_io/",
    "integration: tests that require an external service (e.g. Redis); skipped when unavailable",
    "live: tests that call real external APIs and require explicit opt-in",
]

docs.title: 14.4.2 ​精读​ backend/Makefile ​的​测试​ target
docs.text:
TDD ​是​强制​的​（backend/AGENTS.md:216-222："Every new feature or bug fix MUST be accompanied by unit tests. No exceptions."）。​落地​命令​在​ backend/Makefile:22-36：

# Run all four duration-balanced shards locally; wait for every shard on failure.
TEST_JOBS ?= 4
TEST_SHARD_TARGETS := test-shard-1 test-shard-2 test-shard-3 test-shard-4
.PHONY: test test-shard $(TEST_SHARD_TARGETS)
test:
    $(MAKE) --no-print-directory -k -j$(TEST_JOBS) $(TEST_SHARD_TARGETS)

$(TEST_SHARD_TARGETS):
    $(MAKE) --no-print-directory test-shard SPLITS=4 GROUP=$(patsubst test-shard-%,%,$@)

test-live:
    DEER_FLOW_RUN_LIVE_TESTS=1 PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run pytest -m live tests/ -v -s

test-blocking-io:
    PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run pytest tests/blocking_io -q --tb=short

​三个​看点​：

  1. ​四分​片​并行​——make test ​用​ -j4 ​同时​跑​四个​ test-shard-N，​分片​不是​ ​按​目录​切​，​而是​按时​长​均衡​；
  2. ​时​长​基线​文件​——backend/Makefile:46-52 ​的​ test-shard：
SPLITS ?= 1
GROUP ?= 1
DURATIONS_FILE ?= .test_durations
test-shard:
 @test -f "$(DURATIONS_FILE)" || \
     (echo "error: $(DURATIONS_FILE) is missing; run 'make test-shard-durations' to regenerate the duration baseline" >&2; exit 1)
 PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run pytest -m "not live" --ignore=tests/blocking_io --splits $(SPLITS) --group $(GROUP) --splitting-algorithm least_duration --durations-path=$(DURATIONS_FILE) tests/ -q

pytest-split ​按​ .test_durations ​里​记录​的​真实​耗时​做​ least_duration ​分桶​；​文件​缺失​直接​报错​（​而​不是​退化​成​不​分片​），​避免​ CI ​分片​意外​失衡​。 ​刷新​基线​用​ make test-shard-durations（backend/Makefile:57-58），​它会​ --store-durations --clean-durations ​重测​全量​离线​套件​。 3. ​两套​门禁​都​要​跑​——​提交​前​ make test + make test-blocking-io ​一起​过​ （backend/AGENTS.md:222）。tests/blocking_io/ ​里​跑​的​是​ Blockbuster： ​事件​循环​上​出现​未​授权​的​阻塞​ I/O（​同步​文件​、​同步​网络​）​直接​判红​。​第​ 15 ​章​ ​会​看到​ tests/blocking_io/test_mcp_oauth_token_store.py ​这样​的​成​对​回归​。

​代码​风格​同样​有​门禁​：ruff，​行宽​ 240（backend/AGENTS.md Code Style ​节​， "Line length: 240 characters"）；backend/Makefile:60-62 ​的​ lint ​同时​跑​ ruff check ​与​ ruff format --check，CI ​后者​强制​。

docs.title: 14.4.3 ​数据库​迁移​：make migrate-rev ​与​一个​真实​迁移
docs.text:
​迁移​系统​是​ Alembic，​目录​在​ Harness ​侧​： backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/migrations/。backend/Makefile:77-79：

migrate-rev:
    @if [ -z "$(MSG)" ]; then echo 'usage: make migrate-rev MSG="describe the change"'; exit 1; fi
    PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 PYTHONUTF8=1 uv run python scripts/_autogen_revision.py "$(MSG)"

backend/Makefile:70-76 ​的​注释​解释​了​为什么​没有​ make migrate / migrate-stash ​之类​的​ target：Gateway ​启动​时​通过​ bootstrap_schema ​自动​ alembic upgrade head——​唯一​执行​路径​，​把​运维​失误​挡​在​门外​。​自动​生成​的​算法​ ​是​"​先​在​一个​临时​ SQLite ​上升​到​ head，​再​把​ live ORM ​模型​与​它​做​ diff"，​所以​ ​干净​ checkout（​没有​现成​ ./data/deerflow.db）​也​能​用​。

​一个​真实​的​版本​文件​长​什么样​？​看​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/migrations/versions/0047_mcp_oauth_tokens.py:32-41（​这​张表​正是​第​ 15 ​章​ MCP OAuth token ​存储​的​底座​，​此处​先看​迁移​结构​）：

revision: str = "0047_mcp_oauth_tokens"
down_revision: str | Sequence[str] | None = "0046_skill_mutations"
branch_labels: str | Sequence[str] | None = None
depends_on: str | Sequence[str] | None = None

_TABLE = "mcp_oauth_tokens"


def _has_table() -> bool:
    return sa.inspect(op.get_bind()).has_table(_TABLE)

revision / down_revision ​组成​链表​——​这​就是​"​为什么​迁移​文件​不能​重命名​、 ​不能​跳​号​"​的​原因​。​再​看​它​的​幂​等​守卫​（0047_mcp_oauth_tokens.py:44-47）：

def upgrade() -> None:
    if _has_table():
        return
    op.create_table(

docstring（0047_mcp_oauth_tokens.py:18-23）​解释​了​守卫​的​必要性​：​升级​时​如果​ ​表已​存在​（​早前​中断​的​尝试​，​或​空库​ bootstrap ​已​跑​过​ create_all），​直接​完成​； ​降级​时​如果​表已​消失​，​也​要​继续移动​版本​行​。​迁移​必须​可​在​任意​中间状态​下​重放​ ——​这​是​多​实例​部署​（​第​ 20 ​章​）​的​地基​。

docs.title: 14.5 ​动手​实验​：​定位​一处​中间件​并​跑​通​全部​门禁
docs.text:
​目标​：​在​ Harness ​中​找到​并​读懂​一个​真实​中间件​，​然后​体验​完整​的​改动​闭环​。 ​全程​离线​，​约​ 15 ​分钟​。

​步骤​ 1：​定位​中间件​。 ​第​ 6 ​章见​过​ ClarificationMiddleware ​在​中间件​链​的​ ​位置​。​它​住​在​ Harness：

cd backend
grep -rn "class ClarificationMiddleware" packages/harness/deerflow/
# → packages/harness/deerflow/agents/middlewares/clarification_middleware.py:75

​读​ clarification_middleware.py ​的​类​定义​与其​ AgentMiddleware ​基类​用法​， ​确认​它​只​ import ​了​ deerflow.* ​与​第三方​库​——​没有​任何​ from app...。

​步骤​ 2：​验证​边界​测试​只​扫​静态​结构​（​跑​一次​它​）。

cd backend
uv run pytest tests/test_harness_boundary.py -v
# → test_harness_does_not_import_app PASSED

​步骤​ 3：​制造​一次​违规​，​观察​ CI ​门​的​报错​（​在​本地​复现​）。 ​随便​在​ clarification_middleware.py ​顶部​加​一行​ from app.gateway import app # boundary demo, will remove，​再​跑​：

uv run pytest tests/test_harness_boundary.py -v
# FAILED — Harness layer must not import from app layer:
#   packages/harness/deerflow/agents/middlewares/clarification_middleware.py:1  imports app.gateway.app

​报错​精确​到​文件​与​行号​——​这​正是​将来​ push ​后​ CI ​给​你​的​反馈​。​删掉​这​行​， ​确认​恢复​绿色​。

​步骤​ 4：​跑​全量​门禁​（​体会​时长​与​分片​）。

cd backend
make test                 # ​四分​片​并行​；​首次​运行​若缺​ .test_durations ​先跑​步骤​ 5
make test-blocking-io     # Blockbuster ​套件​
make lint                 # ruff check + ruff format --check

​步骤​ 5（​可​选​）：​刷新​时​长​基线​。 ​如果​ make test ​报​ .test_durations is missing，​执行​ make test-shard-durations ​生成​基线​后​再​ ​跑​ make test。​注意​基线​文件​是​提交​进​仓库​的​——​不要​顺手​改​了​它​内容​。

​验收​标准​：make test、make test-blocking-io、make lint ​全绿​； ​你​能​口头​说出​ ClarificationMiddleware ​所在​文件​、​它​在​中间件​链中​的​位置​、 ​以及​是​谁​保证​它​永远​不会​ import app。

docs.title: 常见​坑
docs.text:
1. ​把​产品​逻辑​写​进​ Harness。​症状​：harness ​模块​里​出现​了​ app.gateway、 app.channels ​的​ import ​或​对​ Gateway ​单例​的​引用​。CI ​红灯​ （test_harness_boundary.py）。​正确​姿势​：​抽象​进​ harness ​接口​、​走​ deerflow_extension_api ​契约​注入​（​第​ 16 ​章​），​或​直接​放​ app.*。
  2. ​改了​版本号​但​只​改​一处​。backend/pyproject.toml、 backend/packages/harness/pyproject.toml、frontend/package.json、 deploy/helm/deer-flow/Chart.yaml（version ​与​ appVersion）​四处​ + backend/uv.lock ​必须​一致​。​手改​必然​漂移​，​用​ scripts/bump_version.sh <ver>， ​验证​用​ scripts/verify_versions.sh <ver>。
  3. ​绕过​ make test ​直接​跑​单个​ pytest。​四分​片​的​意义​是​均衡​ CI ​时​长​； ​本地​可以​用​ uv run pytest tests/test_xxx.py -q ​快速​迭代​单​文件​，​但​提交​前​ ​必须​跑​完整​ make test + make test-blocking-io。​缺​ .test_durations ​时​ make test-shard ​会​直接​报错​——​先跑​ make test-shard-durations。
  4. ​在​轻量​模块​里加​包根​ eager import。from deerflow.agents import ... ​出现​在​配置​/​状态​模块​顶部​会拉起​整张​工具​图​，​测试​里​还​可能​触发​循环​导入​ （conftest ​里​那条​注释​链​）。​写​"​轻量​导入​"​风格​：​直接​ import ​具体​子​模块​， ​重​符号​延迟​到​函数​体内​。
  5. ​手写​ Alembic ​迁移​不写​幂​等​守卫​。​迁移​会​在​多​实例​、​中断​重​放​、 ​空库​ bootstrap ​等​各种​中间状态​下​执行​。​照​ 0047_mcp_oauth_tokens.py ​的​ ​样子​：​升级​前​ _has_table() ​探测​、​降级​同样​探测​；​列级​守卫​用​现成​的​ migrations/_helpers.py。​迁移​文件​一旦​合入​不要​重命名​——revision ​链表​ ​会断​。
  6. ​忘记​ App ​层​"​自己​ import ​的​包​自己​声明​"。​如果​你​在​ app.* ​新增​了​对​ deerflow-extension-api（​或​任何​传递​依赖​）​的​直接​ import，​记得​同步​加进​ backend/pyproject.toml ​的​ dependencies——​否则​ Harness ​侧重​构​传递​ ​依赖​时会​无声​破坏​ App。​这个​纪律​的​成文​理由​见​ backend/pyproject.toml:9-15 ​的​注释​。

docs.title: 下​一步
docs.text: ​分层​与​规范​就位​后​，​接下来​是​精通​篇​的​重头戏​：MCP ​集成​——DeerFlow ​如何​把​ ​外部​系统​工具化​、​如何​用​进程​隔离​的​ MCP server ​扩展​ agent ​能力​、​以及​第​ 15 ​章​ ​动手​"​接入​ GitHub MCP server + ​自​建​ stdio MCP server"​的​两个​实验​。​见​ 《​第​ 15 ​章​ MCP ​集成​》（docs/tutorials/15-mcp.md）；​第​ 15 ​章​之后​的​第​ 16 ​章​ （docs/tutorials/16-extensions.md）​再​把​本章​的​契约​包​落到​扩展​开发​实战​。

docs.title: 第​ 15 ​章​ MCP ​集成​（​重点​）
docs.text: ​第​ 7 ​章​的​工具​三​来源​里​，MCP ​是​唯一​"​不改​一行​核心​代码​就​能​接入​外部​系统​"​的​来源​。 ​本章​拆解​ DeerFlow ​的​ MCP ​子系统​：extensions_config.json ​的​两种​传输​配置​、 ​每​服务器​独立​进程​与​超时​防护​、​工具​如何​合并​进​ get_available_tools()、 Gateway ​热​编辑​的​双锁​与​原子​写​契约​、​把​长​任务​挡​在​ Agent ​循环​之外​的​ McpTaskService，​以及​ mcpInterceptors ​拦截器​。​两个​动手​实验​带​你​完整​走通​ "​接入​ GitHub MCP server → ​自​建​ stdio MCP server → ​调用​ → ​取消​长​任务​"​闭环​。

docs.title: 本章​源码​锚点
docs.text: 主题​ ​锚点​ MCP ​子系统​守则​（​必读​） backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/AGENTS.md ​配置​模型​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:218（McpServerConfig） ​示例​配置​（​四种​服务器​） extensions_config.example.json ​连接​参数​构建​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/client.py:12（build_server_params） ​工具​发现​/​包装​/​前缀​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tools.py:1060、:1106、:655 ​工具​缓存​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/cache.py:1188（get_cached_mcp_tools） stdio ​会话池​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/session_pool.py:183（MAX_SESSIONS = 256） ​工具​合并​入口​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tools/tools.py:103（get_available_tools） ​拦截器​链​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/interceptors.py:18 ​双锁​与​原子​写​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:955、:958、:717 ​长​任务​服务​ backend/app/mcp_tasks/service.py:102（McpTaskService） ​长​任务​持久​化​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/mcp_tasks/model.py:17（McpTaskRow） ​长​任务​驱动​协议​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tasks/driver.py:9（McpTaskDriver） ​控制​租约​文档​ backend/docs/mcp-control-leases.md MCP ​配置​官方​文档​ backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md Gateway MCP ​路由​ backend/app/gateway/routers/mcp.py（7 ​个​端点​）+ routers/mcp_tasks.py ​双锁​/​原子​写​测试​ backend/tests/test_extensions_config_atomic_write.py、backend/tests/test_compose_extensions_config_writable.py

docs.title: 15.0 ​学习​目标
docs.text:
​读完​本章​，​你​应该​能够​：

  1. ​写出​ stdio（command/args/env）​与​ http（url/headers）​两种​ mcpServers ​配置​，​并​解释​ $ENV_VAR ​运行​时​解析​、tool_name_prefix、 session_init_timeout、tool_call_timeout ​四个​键​的​行为​；
  2. ​描述​一次​ MCP ​工具​调用​从​"​配置文件​ → ​连接​参数​ → ​每​服务器​独立​发现​ → ​会话池​ → ​合并​进​ get_available_tools()"​的​完整​路径​；
  3. ​说出​ Gateway ​热​编辑​ extensions_config.json ​的​双锁​契约​ （extensions_config_write_lock + extensions_config_file_lock）​与​ atomic_write_extensions_config ​的​临时文件​替换​语义​，​以及​ Compose ​中​ "​该​文件​可​写​、config.yaml ​只读​"​的​原因​；
  4. ​解释​ McpTaskService ​为什么​把​远端​任务​ ID/​轮询​挡​在​ Agent ​循环​之外​ （​租约​、DB ​为​真相​源​、​通知​重试​/​死信​、​取消​端点​ worker-stopped 503）；
  5. ​独立​完成​ GitHub MCP server ​接入​与​自建​ stdio MCP server ​并​在​对话​中​调用​。

docs.title: 15.1.1 ​四键​骨架​：middlewares / mcpInterceptors / mcpServers / skills
docs.text:
MCP ​服务器​与​技能​同​住​一份​ extensions_config.json（​仓库​根​，gitignored，​从​ extensions_config.example.json ​复制​）。​顶层​四个​键​（​第​ 16 ​章会​再​见到​它们​）： middlewares（Agent ​中间件​类​路径​）、mcpInterceptors（MCP ​工具​拦截器​）、 mcpServers（​服务器​映射​）、skills（​技能​开关​）。Pydantic ​模型​在​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:399-420：

class ExtensionsConfig(BaseModel):
    """Unified configuration for MCP servers and skills."""

    middlewares: list[str | ConfiguredMiddlewareSpec] = Field(...)
    mcp_servers: dict[str, McpServerConfig] = Field(
        default_factory=dict,
        description="Map of MCP server name to configuration",
        alias="mcpServers",
    )
    skills: dict[str, SkillStateConfig] = Field(...)
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="allow", populate_by_name=True)

​单个​服务器​的​配置​模型​是​ McpServerConfig （backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:218-272）。 ​先看​本章​的​四个​主角​字​段​（:241-261）：

    tool_name_prefix: bool = Field(
        default=True,
        description="Whether to prefix discovered tool names with the MCP server name to avoid cross-server collisions",
    )
    tool_call_timeout: float | None = Field(
        default=None,
        gt=0,
        allow_inf_nan=False,
        description=("Timeout in seconds for individual stdio MCP tool calls and durable-task calls on every transport. Other HTTP/SSE tools use transport-level timeouts. None means no call-level timeout."),
    )
    session_init_timeout: float | None = Field(
        default=DEFAULT_MCP_SESSION_INIT_TIMEOUT,
        gt=0,
        allow_inf_nan=False,
        description=(
            "Timeout in seconds for MCP server bring-up: tool discovery (subprocess spawn + initialize + tools/list) "
            "and persistent stdio session initialization, plus ephemeral HTTP/SSE durable-task session "
            "initialization. Defaults to DEFAULT_MCP_SESSION_INIT_TIMEOUT so a hung server cannot block agent "
            "construction or the task poller indefinitely. None means no timeout."
        ),
    )
  • tool_name_prefix（​默认​ true）：​发现​到​的​工具​名​加上​ <server_name>_ ​前缀​， ​避免​两台​服务器​暴露​同名​工具​时​冲突​。​服务器​自身​已带​命名​空间​时​可​关掉​ （backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:216-240 ​的​ semantic-scholar ​例子​）。
  • session_init_timeout：​服务器​"​从​拉​起到​应答​"​的​期限​——stdio ​是子​进程​ spawn + initialize + tools/list ​的​全过程​；​默认值​为​常量​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/constants.py:61： DEFAULT_MCP_SESSION_INIT_TIMEOUT = 60.0。​设​为​ null ​可显式​关闭​。
  • tool_call_timeout：​单次​工具​调用​的​期限​（stdio ​调用​ + ​所有​传输​上​的​长​任务​ ​调用​）；​普通​ http/sse ​工具​走​传输层​超时​。

docs.title: 15.1.2 ​真实​配置​示例​：stdio ​与​ http
docs.text:
​仓库​自带​的​ extensions_config.example.json ​给​了​四台​示例​服务器​，​全部​默认​ enabled: false。stdio ​型​（extensions_config.example.json:7-22）：

    "github": {
      "enabled": false,
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"
      ],
      "env": {
        "GITHUB_TOKEN": "$GITHUB_TOKEN"
      },
      "tool_name_prefix": true,
      "session_init_timeout": 60,
      "tool_call_timeout": 60,
      "description": "GitHub MCP server for repository operations"
    },

http ​型​（extensions_config.example.json:23-31）：

    "parallel-search": {
      "enabled": false,
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://search.parallel.ai/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "User-Agent": "deer-flow"
      },
      "description": "Optional anonymous Parallel Search tools for web search and fetching requested URLs"
    },

​两种​传输​的​字​段​分野​清晰​：stdio ​用​ command/args/env（​可​选​ cwd），http/sse ​用​ url/headers（​可​选​ oauth、user_auth、headers_from_context）。​同一​ ​文件​里​还有​一台​演示​软​路由​提示​的​ stdio ​服务器​（extensions_config.example.json:41-76）： postgres ​在​服务器​级​与​ tools.query ​工具​级​各配​一个​ routing ​块​ （mode: prefer、priority、keywords）——​它们​只​影响​提示​词里​的​ <mcp_routing_hints> ​推荐​段​与​ tool_search ​自动​提升​，​不会​硬禁​其他​工具​ （backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:160-215）。

docs.title: 15.1.3 $ENV_VAR ​运行​时​解析
docs.text:
​配置​里​凡是​以​ $ ​开头​的​整串​字符串​，​加载​时​递归​解析​为​环境变量​。​实现​在​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:570-601：

    @classmethod
    def resolve_env_variables(cls, config: Any) -> Any:
        """Recursively resolve environment variables in the config.

        Environment variables are resolved using the `os.getenv` function. Example: $OPENAI_API_KEY
        """
        if isinstance(config, str):
            if not config.startswith("$"):
                return config
            env_value = os.getenv(config[1:])
            if env_value is None:
                # Unresolved placeholder — store empty string so downstream
                # consumers (e.g. MCP servers) don't receive the literal "$VAR"
                # token as an actual environment value.
                return ""
            return env_value
        ...

​两个​必须​记住​的​副作用​：

  1. ​未​设置​的​变量​解析​为​空串​，​不是​保留​字面​ $VAR——​下游​（​比如​ stdio ​子​进程​ ​环境​）​拿​不到​占位​符​原文​；
  2. from_file() ​返回​的​模型​已​把​密钥​展开​，​因此​永远​不能​把​它​序列化​写回​磁盘​ （​会​把​明文​密钥​持久​化​、​把​ $VAR ​引用​抹掉​）。​写回​必须​走​ read_raw_extensions_config()（:776-793，"This is the only safe merge source for a read-modify-write"）——15.3 ​节​的​热​编辑​链路​正​建立​在​这条​规则​上​。

docs.title: 15.1.4 ​从​配置​到​连接​参数​：build_server_params
docs.text:
​发现​工具​前​，​每台​服务器​先​被​翻译成​ langchain-mcp-adapters ​的​连接​参数​。 backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/client.py:12-60（​摘录​主干​）：

def build_server_params(server_name: str, config: McpServerConfig) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build server parameters for MultiServerMCPClient."""
    transport_type = config.type or "stdio"
    params: dict[str, Any] = {"transport": transport_type}

    if transport_type == "stdio":
        if not config.command:
            raise ValueError(f"MCP server '{server_name}' with stdio transport requires 'command' field")
        params["command"] = config.command
        params["args"] = config.args
        if config.cwd:
            params["cwd"] = config.cwd
        # Add environment variables if present
        if config.env:
            params["env"] = config.env
    elif transport_type in ("sse", "http"):
        if not config.url:
            raise ValueError(f"MCP server '{server_name}' with {transport_type} transport requires 'url' field")
        params["url"] = config.url
        # Add headers if present
        if config.headers:
            # A statically configured value the transport would refuse gets the
            # same treatment as a request-scoped one: h11 renders the full
            # value into its exception on a line break or surrounding
            # whitespace, which reaches the model through
            # ToolErrorHandlingMiddleware. ...
            for header_name, header_value in config.headers.items():
                reason = illegal_header_value_reason(header_value)
                if reason is not None:
                    raise ValueError(f"MCP server '{server_name}' has a header '{header_name}' that cannot be sent as an HTTP header value: it {reason}")
            params["headers"] = config.headers
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"MCP server '{server_name}' has unsupported transport type: {transport_type}")

​注意​ http ​分支​里​的​ illegal_header_value_reason ​检查​：​换行​、​首尾​空白​、​非​ ASCII ​的​静态​ header ​会​在​配置​阶段​直接​拒绝​该​服务器​。​理由​在​注释​里​——h11 ​的​报错​会​把​ ​完整​ header ​值​（​常常​就是​ API key）​回显进​异常​消息​，​而​工具​错误​是​ model-visible ​的​，​等于​把​密钥​泄进​提示​词​、checkpoint ​与​ trace。 build_servers_config（client.py:63-86）​逐台​调用​它​，​单台​失败​只​丢弃​该​服务器​ ​并记​日志​，​不​拖垮​其余​服务器​。

​配置​模型​还​接受​ MCP ​规范​的​ transport ​拼写​作为​ type ​的​别名​ （extensions_config.py:291-303 ​的​ _accept_transport_alias），​两种​写法​等价​。

docs.title: 15.2.1 ​每​服务器​独立​发现​：​一个​慢​服务器​不​拖累​别人
docs.text:
​发现​被​拆成​"​每​服务器​一个​客户端​ + ​一次​独立​ discovery await"。 backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tools.py:1060-1103 ​的​ _prepare_server_client ​为​单个​服务器​构建​ MultiServerMCPClient（​注意​ client_cls({server_name: connection}, ...)——​字典​里​只有​这​一台​），​并​把​ tool_name_prefix ​与​ session_init_timeout ​一并​带​出​：

def _prepare_server_client(
    extensions_config: ExtensionsConfig,
    server_name: str,
    connection: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    client_cls: Any,
    initial_oauth_header: str | None,
    oauth_token_manager: OAuthTokenManager,
) -> _PreparedServerClient:
    """Build the client/interceptors for one selected server."""
    server_cfg = extensions_config.mcp_servers.get(server_name)
    transport = connection.get("transport", "stdio")
    tool_name_prefix = server_cfg.tool_name_prefix if server_cfg is not None else True
    session_init_timeout = _resolve_session_init_timeout(server_cfg)
    server_view = extensions_config.model_copy(
        update={"mcp_servers": {server_name: extensions_config.mcp_servers[server_name]}},
    )
    tool_interceptors = build_mcp_tool_interceptors(
        server_view,
        oauth_builder=lambda config: build_oauth_tool_interceptor(config, token_manager=oauth_token_manager),
        resolver=resolve_variable,
        target_logger=logger,
    )
    ...
    client = client_cls(
        {server_name: connection},
        tool_interceptors=tool_interceptors,
        tool_name_prefix=True,
    )

server_view ​是​只​含​这​一台​服务器​的​配置​副本​——​拦截器​构建​者​拿到​的​是​"​单​服务器​ ​视图​"（backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/AGENTS.md ​与​ backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:643-649 ​均​强调​：​有​状态​的​拦截器​实例​每​服务器​一份​， ​不要​假设​跨​服务器​共享​）。

​真正​带​超时​的​发现​在​ tools.py:1106-1144：

        if prepared_client.session_init_timeout is not None:
            # Timeout tool discovery (subprocess spawn + initialize +
            # tools/list) so a hung stdio server cannot block agent
            # construction indefinitely. This runs per server so one slow
            # server does not prevent healthy siblings from contributing.
            try:
                server_tools = await asyncio.wait_for(discovery, timeout=prepared_client.session_init_timeout)
            except TimeoutError:
                logger.warning(
                    "Skipping MCP server '%s' after tool discovery timed out (%.1fs)",
                    server_name,
                    prepared_client.session_init_timeout,
                )
                return server_name, None

​超时​的​服务器​被​跳​过​（​返回​ None），​健康​的​兄弟​服务器​照常​发布​工具​；​一台​ npx -y ​卡​在​下载​包​上​，​不会​让​整次​ agent ​构建​挂​起​。​这​就是​"​进程​隔离​与​开关​"​的​ ​第二层​含义​：​隔离​不仅​发生​在​运行​期​（​独立​子​进程​/​独立​连接​），​也​发生​在​发现​期​ （​独立​超时​、​独立​失败​）。enabled: false ​或​删除​配置​条目​则​把​一台​服务器​从​ ​上述​流程​里​完全​摘除​；​启用​/​停用​可​在​运行​时​通过​ API ​切换​（15.3 ​节​）。

stdio ​服务器​在​运行​期​还有​第三重​隔离​：​持久​会话池​。​池​按​ (server_name, user/thread/incarnation scope, ownership domain) ​键控​， MCPSessionPool.MAX_SESSIONS = 256 ​是​硬​上限​（backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/session_pool.py:186）；​工具​包装​器​ _make_session_pool_tool（tools.py:655）​把​每次​调用​放进​池化会​话​，​有​状态​的​ stdio ​服务器​（​如​ Playwright）​在​同一​线程​内​保持​状态​，​又​按​用户​/​线程​隔离​。

docs.title: 15.2.2 ​工具​名​前缀​的​两处​剥离
docs.text:
tool_name_prefix=true ​时​，​适配器​给​工具​名加​ <server_name>_ ​前缀​；DeerFlow ​需要​在​两个​方向​还原​"​原始​工具​名​"：​路由​查找​按​原名​校验​、task_toolsets ​绑定​的​是​远端​原始​名​。​第一​处在​会话池​工具​包装​器里​ （backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tools.py:678-683）：

    # Strip only prefixes added by the adapter. An unprefixed server may expose
    # a tool whose own name happens to start with ``<server_name>_``.
    original_name = tool.name
    prefix = f"{server_name}_"
    if tool_name_prefix and original_name.startswith(prefix):
        original_name = original_name[len(prefix) :]

​第二​处在​发现​后​的​包装​循环​（tools.py:1197-1202）：​剥离​前缀​得到​ original_name，​用​它​解析​ resolve_effective_mcp_routing(server_cfg, original_name) ——extensions_config.json → mcpServers.<server>.tools.<​原始​工具​名​>.routing ​的​键​是​加前缀​之前​的​名字​。​守则​文件​ mcp/AGENTS.md:53 ​补充​了​边界​： ​源​路由​与​ stdio ​会话池​包装​基于​"​产出​的​服务器​与​传输​"，​与​可见​名​是否​带​前缀​无关​。

docs.title: 15.2.3 ​合并​进​ get_available_tools()
docs.text:
Agent ​组装​时​工具​来自​四路​合并​（​第​ 7 ​章​讲​过​三路​，​这里​看​ MCP ​一路​的​实现​）。 backend/packages/harness/deerflow/tools/tools.py:251-268：

    mcp_tools = []
    if include_mcp:
        try:
            from deerflow.config.extensions_config import ExtensionsConfig
            from deerflow.mcp.cache import get_cached_mcp_tools, refresh_mcp_cache_if_active

            try:
                extensions_config = ExtensionsConfig.from_file()
            except Exception as exc:
                # Only this call carries the resolved-credential risk:
                # from_file() resolves $VAR values before validation, so a
                # ValidationError message can embed secrets. Log the type only.
                logger.error("Failed to load MCP extensions config (%s)", type(exc).__name__)
            else:
                if extensions_config.get_enabled_mcp_servers():
                    mcp_tools = get_cached_mcp_tools()
                    if mcp_tools:
                        logger.info(f"Using {len(mcp_tools)} cached MCP tool(s)")

​要点​：from_file() ​每次​直读​磁盘​（​注释​里​说明​了​为什么​——Gateway ​在​独立​进程​里​ ​改​配置​后​，​这里​要​立刻​反映​）；​读取​失败​只记​异常​类型​不记​消息​（​消息​可能​内嵌​ ​解析​出​的​密钥​）；​有​启用​服务器​才​走​ get_cached_mcp_tools()（​带​文件​签名​两段式​ ​失效​检查​，​见​ mcp/cache.py:1188），​否则​调​ refresh_mcp_cache_if_active() ​退役​旧​缓存​与​池化会​话​。​随后​把​个人​ MCP ​工具​并入​、​按​服务器​名​碰撞​去​重​ （tools.py:293-302），​最后​与​其他​来源​统一​按​工具​名去​重​ （tools.py:339-355，​重复​名会​让​ LLM ​收到​歧义​ schema——issue #1803）：

    ordinary_tools = loaded_tools + builtin_tools + mcp_tools + acp_tools
    ...
    seen_names: set[str] = set()
    unique_tools: list[BaseTool] = []
    for t in all_tools:
        if t.name not in seen_names:
            unique_tools.append(t)
            seen_names.add(t.name)
        else:
            logger.warning(
                "Duplicate tool name %r detected and skipped — check your config.yaml and MCP server registrations (issue #1803).",
                t.name,
            )
    return unique_tools

​顺带​一提​：tools.py:186-187 ​里​ is_mcp_task_runtime_available() ​为​真时​， ​内置​工具​里​还​会​追加​ list_background_tasks / cancel_background_task ​两个​ ​管理工具​——​这是​ 15.4 ​节长​任务​运行​时​对​ Agent ​的​唯一​可​见面​。

docs.title: 15.3.1 Gateway ​的​ 7 ​个​ MCP ​端点
docs.text: MCP ​配置​在​运行​时可经​ Gateway API ​修改​（backend/app/gateway/routers/mcp.py）： GET /api/mcp/config（:1138）、POST /api/mcp/cache/reset（:1550）、 PUT /api/mcp/config（​整包​替换​，:1579）、POST /api/mcp/config/servers （​新增​，:1638）、PUT /api/mcp/config/server（​替换​单台​，:1660）、 DELETE /api/mcp/config/servers/{server_name}（:1685）、 PATCH /api/mcp/config（​只改​ enabled，:1706）。API ​是​不可​信​输入​边界​： _validate_mcp_update_request（routers/mcp.py:769）​对​ stdio ​命令​做​白名单​ （​默认​ {npx, uvx}，​可用​ DEER_FLOW_MCP_STDIO_COMMAND_ALLOWLIST ​扩展​）、 ​拒绝​任意​执行​参数​与​注入​代码​的​环境变量​（PYTHONPATH/PYTHONHOME ​等​）。 backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/AGENTS.md:79 ​的​提醒​值得​原样​复述​： ​这是​纵深​防御​而​非​信任​边界​——​边界​是​管理员​认证​加​网络​可达性​。

docs.title: 15.3.2 ​双锁​：​进程​内​ + ​跨​进程
docs.text:
​写​配置​是​"​读​ → ​合并​ → ​写回​ → ​重载​"​的​读​改写​循环​。​两个​写方​（MCP ​路由​与​技能​ ​开关​）​并发​交错​会​互相​吞掉​改动​，​所以​有​两把​锁​。​第一把​，​进程​内线​程锁​ （backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/extensions_config.py:939-955）：

#: Serializes read-modify-write cycles on ``extensions_config.json`` across every
#: writer. Both the skills router (skill enable/disable) and the MCP router
#: (server config updates) read this file, merge a change and write it back.
#: ...
#: This is a ``threading.Lock`` rather than an ``asyncio.Lock``, and it must be
#: acquired *inside* the worker that performs the RMW. An asyncio lock held
#: around ``await asyncio.to_thread(...)`` protects only the awaiting task: if
#: that task is cancelled the context manager releases immediately while the
#: worker thread keeps writing, letting a second writer in. Owning the lock from
#: the worker keeps it held until the write and reload actually finish. It also
#: has no event-loop affinity, so writers running on different loops still
#: exclude each other.
extensions_config_write_lock = threading.Lock()

​锁名​是​ extensions_config_write_lock（backend/AGENTS.md:22 ​的​"hold both extensions_config_write_lock and the sidecar advisory extensions_config_file_lock"​即​指​这​两把​）。​为什么​是​ threading.Lock ​而​不是​ asyncio.Lock：​读​改写​被​ offload ​到​工作​线程​执行​，asyncio ​锁​只​护住​ await ​点​， ​任务​一​取消​锁​就​放​、​线程​还​在​写​——​线程​锁​必须​在​执行​写​的​工作​线程​内​获取​。

​第二把​，​跨​进程​的​ sidecar ​文件​锁​（extensions_config.py:958-996）：

@contextmanager
def extensions_config_file_lock(path: Path) -> Iterator[None]:
    """Exclude read-modify-write cycles in other Gateway processes.

    ``extensions_config_write_lock`` serializes threads in this process. This
    sidecar advisory lock extends the same critical section across worker
    processes and separate embedded clients that share the config directory.
    Callers must hold both locks around the complete read, merge, write, and
    reload cycle; locking only the final atomic replace still permits lost
    updates.
    """
    ...
    lock_path = target_path.parent / f".{target_path.name}.lock"

    with open(lock_path, "a+b") as lock_file:
        if os.name == "nt":
            import msvcrt
            ...
            msvcrt.locking(lock_file.fileno(), msvcrt.LK_LOCK, 1)
        else:
            import fcntl
            fcntl.flock(lock_file.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX)

​锁​文件​是​配置​旁边​的​ .<​配置​名​>.lock；Windows ​走​ msvcrt.locking，POSIX ​走​ fcntl.flock。​多​ worker / ​多​实例​共享​同​一份​配置​目录​时​，​谁​先​拿到​文件​锁​谁​完成​ ​整个​读​改写​。​跨​进程​排他性​有​测试​钉住​： backend/tests/test_extensions_config_atomic_write.py:182-204 ​用​ multiprocessing fork ​两个​子​进程​各​做​一次​带锁​的​读​改写​，​断言​后写​的​进程​在​ ​前者​持锁​期间​进不去​、​最终​两次​改动​都​落盘​。

docs.title: 15.3.3 ​原子​写​：​临时文件​替换​与​ EBUSY ​回退
docs.text:
​写回​不是​ open(..., "w") ​就​完事​——​崩溃​写​到​一半​的​文件​会​留下​残废​配置​。 atomic_write_extensions_config（extensions_config.py:717-773）​的​核心​段​ （:741-763）：

        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            mode="w",
            encoding="utf-8",
            dir=target_path.parent,
            prefix=f".{target_path.name}.",
            suffix=".tmp",
            delete=False,
        ) as temporary_file:
            temporary_path = Path(temporary_file.name)
            json.dump(data, temporary_file, indent=2)
            if existing_mode is not None:
                temporary_path.chmod(existing_mode)
            temporary_file.flush()
            os.fsync(temporary_file.fileno())

        try:
            os.replace(temporary_path, target_path)
        except OSError as exc:
            if exc.errno != errno.EBUSY:
                raise
            _log_non_atomic_fallback(target_path)
            _overwrite_in_place(target_path, temporary_path)
        _fsync_directory_best_effort(target_path.parent)

​语义​链​：​同​目录​临时文件​（​同​目录​保证​ os.replace ​原子​）→ ​写​完​ fsync → os.replace ​原子​替换​ → ​目录​ fsync（POSIX）。​失败​路径​全部​保旧​文件​、​清理​临时​ ​文件​（test_extensions_config_atomic_write.py:60-128 ​逐一​钉住​ json.dump / replace / fsync ​三种​失败​）。​唯一​例外​是​ EBUSY：Docker ​把​ extensions_config.json ​单独​挂载​为​挂载​点​，​内核​拒绝​ rename ​覆盖​挂载​点​， ​此时​退化​为​就​地​覆盖​（​会​丢​原子​性​，​每个​目标​只​警告​一次​）。

​这个​ EBUSY ​回退​正是​ backend/tests/test_extensions_config_atomic_write.py:131-158 ​的​内容​：

def test_atomic_write_falls_back_in_place_when_destination_is_a_mount_point(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    """Docker mounts extensions_config.json as its own mount point, and the kernel
    answers rename-over-a-mount-point with EBUSY. The write must still land."""
    ...
    def refuse_replace(_source, _destination) -> None:
        raise OSError(errno.EBUSY, "Device or resource busy")
    ...
    # The destination inode must survive: replacing it is exactly what the
    # kernel refused, and a mount point that got unlinked would break the mount.
    assert config_path.stat().st_ino == original_inode

docs.title: 15.3.4 Compose ​的​可​写性​契约
docs.text:
​连带​的​生产​约束​由​ backend/tests/test_compose_extensions_config_writable.py:73-80 ​钉死​：

def test_extensions_config_is_mounted_writable() -> None:
    mount = _gateway_volume_for(EXTENSIONS_CONFIG_TARGET)
    assert "ro" not in _mount_options(mount), f"the Gateway writes {EXTENSIONS_CONFIG_TARGET} at runtime, so it must not be mounted read-only: {mount}"


def test_app_config_stays_read_only() -> None:
    mount = _gateway_volume_for(APP_CONFIG_TARGET)
    assert "ro" in _mount_options(mount), f"no API writes {APP_CONFIG_TARGET}; it must stay read-only: {mount}"

​生产​ Compose ​里​ extensions_config.json ​必须​读写​挂载​（Gateway ​要​热​写​它​）， config.yaml ​必须​只读​（​没有​ API ​写​它​；​它​携带​的​顶层​ plugins: ​列表​会​触发​ ​代码​导入​，​必须​留在​ operator ​专属​、API ​写​不到​的​文件​里​——​见​该​测试​ test_compose_extensions_config_writable.py:19-21 ​的​注释​）。​这​是​第​ 3 ​章​ "​两份​配置​各管​什么​"​的​源码​级​落点​。​读取​侧​的​新鲜度​由​文件​签名​重​校验​保证​： get_extensions_config()（extensions_config.py:887-936）​每次​调用​对比​ (mtime, size, sha256) ​签名​，​其他​ worker ​写​的​文件​在​下次​读取​时​自动​可见​—— backend/packages/harness/deerflow/config/AGENTS.md ​的​ "Extensions Config Caching" ​节​（config/AGENTS.md:135 ​附近​）​是​权威​描述​。

docs.title: 15.4.1 ​问题​与​结构
docs.text:
​有些​ MCP ​工具​天​生长​时​（​生成​报告​、​跑​数据​管道​）。​若​让​ Agent ​循环​自己​轮询​， ​一个​ run ​要​挂​住​几分钟​到​几小时​，​还​要求​模型​"​记住​"​远端​任务​ ID。DeerFlow ​的​ ​答案​是​一个​独立​的​持久​任务​运行​时​：backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/AGENTS.md:81-84 ​总结​为​——

Long-running MCP work uses a separate durable task runtime rather than keeping remote task IDs or status polling inside the Agent loop. Explicit task_toolsets bind raw submit/status/cancel names; only submit remains Agent-visible, and its wrapper persists the remote handle before returning a local ID.

​服务器​侧用​ task_toolsets ​声明​"​普通​提交​/​状态​/​取消​"​三件套​（​示例​见​ extensions_config.example.json:77-92 ​的​ long-running-reports）：

    "long-running-reports": {
      "enabled": false,
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://reports.example.com/mcp",
      "description": "Example ordinary MCP background-task contract",
      "session_init_timeout": 60,
      "tool_call_timeout": 60,
      "task_toolsets": [
        {
          "name": "report-generation",
          "submit_tool": "submit_report",
          "status_tool": "get_report_status",
          "cancel_tool": "cancel_report"
        }
      ]
    }

​三个​名字​是​服务器​原始​工具​名​（​与​展示​前缀​无关​，extensions_config.py:80-96 ​的​ McpTaskToolsetConfig）。​协议​约束​（backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:348-378）： ​三件套​必须​返回​ MCP structuredContent；submit ​快速​返回​ {"task_id": ..., "status": "running"}；​状态​取值​ running/input_required/completed/failed/cancelled；error_code: "task_not_found" ​是​永久​失败​，​而​ isError: true ​的​状态​调用​只是​调用​本身​ ​失败​（​可​重试​）——​远端​任务​真​失败​必须​通过​正常​结果​里​的​ structuredContent.status="failed" ​表达​。

​服务​类​在​ App ​层​：backend/app/mcp_tasks/service.py:102-103：

class McpTaskService:
    """Persist and poll long-running MCP tasks outside the Agent loop."""

​构造​依赖​（service.py:105-134）​暴露​了​运行​时​形状​：repository（SQL ​存储​）、 drivers（​协议​注册表​）、poll_interval_seconds / lease_seconds / max_concurrent_polls ​等​参数​、​可选​的​ launch_notification（​任务​完成​时以​ Agent run ​的​形式​把​结果​送回​线程​）。​对应​配置​段​是​ config.yaml → mcp_tasks: （config.example.yaml:2915-2932：enabled ​默认​ false、poll_interval_seconds: 5、 lease_seconds: 120、max_concurrent_polls: 8……​全部​ restart-required）。

docs.title: 15.4.2 ​持久​化​：mcp_tasks ​表
docs.text:
backend/packages/harness/deerflow/persistence/mcp_tasks/model.py:17-30：

class McpTaskRow(Base):
    __tablename__ = "mcp_tasks"

    id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), primary_key=True)
    user_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True)
    thread_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64), index=True)
    ...
    server_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(MCP_TASK_SERVER_NAME_MAX_LENGTH))
    driver_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(64))
    remote_task_id: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(MCP_TASK_REMOTE_ID_MAX_LENGTH))
    task_name: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(MCP_TASK_NAME_MAX_LENGTH))
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), index=True)

​注意​表里​没有​ Agent ​看得见​的​远端​任务​ ID ​字​段​直接​暴露​给​模型​—— remote_task_id ​存在​行里​，Agent ​侧​只​拿到​本地​ id。​轮询​/​取消​/​通知​三套​调度​ ​字​段​（next_poll_at / next_cancel_at / next_notification_at、​各自​的​重试​ ​计数​与​租约​列​）​都​在​ model.py:42-63。​归属​唯一​约束​在​ model.py:72-78：

    __table_args__ = (
        UniqueConstraint(
            "user_id",
            "server_name",
            "remote_task_id",
            name="uq_mcp_tasks_user_server_remote",
        ),
        Index("ix_mcp_tasks_thread_created", "thread_id", "created_at"),
        Index("ix_mcp_tasks_due", "status", "next_poll_at"),
        Index("ix_mcp_tasks_notification_due", "notification_status", "next_notification_at"),
        Index("ix_mcp_tasks_cancel_due", "cancel_requested_at", "next_cancel_at"),
    )

uq_mcp_tasks_user_server_remote ​防止​同一​ (​用户​, ​服务器​, ​远端​任务​) ​重复​入库​； ​三个​ ix_mcp_tasks_*_due ​索引​分别​服务​轮询​/​通知​/​取消​三类​"​到期​扫描​"。

docs.title: 15.4.3 ​租约​：​崩溃​恢复​与​控制​调用​所有权
docs.text:
lease_seconds（​默认​ 120）​是​崩溃​恢复​窗口​，​不是​远程​调用​超时​ （backend/docs/mcp-control-leases.md:3-6）。​工作​方式​：worker ​认领​到期​行时​ ​写入​ lease_owner / lease_token / lease_expires_at；​过期​未​释放​的​租约​就是​ "​前任​已死​"​的​信号​，​别的​ worker ​可以​接手​——​这是​重启​后​队列​存活​的​机制​。 SQLite ​不​支持​ SELECT FOR UPDATE，​认领​事务​用​条件​ UPDATE ​复核​/BEGIN IMMEDIATE ​预留​写者​，PostgreSQL ​用​ FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED （mcp-control-leases.md:17-22）。​状态​/​取消​这​类​"​控制​调用​"​在​远程​请求​期间​ ​每​ lease/3 ​续租​一次​（mcp-control-leases.md:24-31），​续租​失败​即​停止​本地​操作​， ​任务​本地​所有权​栅栏​会​挡住​"​吞掉​了​取消​的​驱动​"​稍后​写​回​的​过期​快照​。

​协议​无关​的​驱动​接口​在​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tasks/driver.py:9-14：

class McpTaskDriver(Protocol):
    """Transport/protocol adapter used by the protocol-neutral task runtime."""

    async def submit(self, request: TaskSubmitRequest) -> TaskSubmission: ...

    async def get_status(self, task: TaskReference) -> TaskSnapshot: ...

    async def cancel(self, task: TaskReference) -> TaskSnapshot: ...

McpTaskDriverRegistry（​同​文件​ :17-38）​在​ Gateway ​启动​时​装配​；​普通​ submit/status/cancel ​契约​的​实现​是​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/tasks/ordinary.py:171 ​的​ OrdinaryMcpTaskDriver（submit ​在​ :177，cancel ​在​ :224），​它​只读​ MCP structuredContent、​把​远端​ running ​映射​为​本地​ working。

docs.title: 15.4.4 ​通知​、​取消​与​可用性​边界
docs.text:
​任务​终态​与​ input_required ​通过​幂​等​ Agent run​送回​原​线程​：​通知​有​独立​的​ ​连续​失败​计数​、​上限​指数​退避​、5 ​次​尝试​预算​，​永久​拒绝​（​如​目标​线程​缺失​）​直接​ ​死信​；​通知​ launch ​前先​做​ owner/token/version/expiry ​栅栏​化​的​ notification_status=launching ​预留​，busy-thread ​冲突​保留​预留​态​与​幂​等​键​等​ ​重试​（mcp/AGENTS.md:84）。​取消​走​ HTTP ​端点​ backend/app/gateway/routers/mcp_tasks.py:204-209：

    if not getattr(request.app.state, "mcp_tasks_available", False):
        ...
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="MCP task cancellation worker is not running")

worker ​不​在​（​例如​ mcp_tasks.enabled=false）​就​返回​ worker-stopped 503—— ​取消​绝不会​被​"​确认​"​却​没有​ worker ​去​执行​。​运行​时​可用性​是​启动​级​事实​： mcp_tasks ​是​ startup-only ​配置​，​改了​磁盘​上​的​键​不​重启​不​生效​；​安装​在​本​进程​的​ submitter ​是​管理工具​暴露​与否​的​唯一​真相​（mcp/AGENTS.md:16 ​与​ :82）。 Agent ​能​主动​做​的​只有​两件事​：​提交​（submit ​包装​器​持久​化​远端​句柄​后​只​返回​本地​ ​任务​ ID），​以及​用​内置​管理工具​ list_background_tasks / cancel_background_task ​查询​/​取消​（tools/tools.py:186-187）。​当前​线程​的​ ​任务​详情​另有​ REST ​查询​：GET /api/threads/{thread_id}/mcp-tasks ​与​ GET /api/threads/{thread_id}/mcp-tasks/{task_id}（backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:386-390）。

docs.title: 15.5 ​拦截器​：mcpInterceptors
docs.text:
​每次​ MCP ​工具​调用​前会​经过​一条​拦截器​链​：​内置​的​ OAuth、​按​用户​凭证​ （user_auth）、​按​请求​凭证​（headers_from_context），​最后​是​配置​声明​的​自定义​ ​拦截器​。​构建​函数​在​ backend/packages/harness/deerflow/mcp/interceptors.py:18-49（​摘录​）：

def build_mcp_tool_interceptors(
    extensions_config: ExtensionsConfig,
    *,
    oauth_builder: Any = build_oauth_tool_interceptor,
    user_auth_builder: Any = build_user_scoped_auth_interceptor,
    context_headers_builder: Any = build_context_headers_interceptor,
    resolver: Any = resolve_variable,
    target_logger: logging.Logger = logger,
) -> list[Any]:
    """Build OAuth, user-scoped auth, context headers, then custom MCP interceptors."""
    interceptors: list[Any] = []
    oauth_interceptor = oauth_builder(extensions_config)
    if oauth_interceptor is not None:
        interceptors.append(oauth_interceptor)

    # After OAuth so a server declaring both gets the per-user credential:
    # interceptors wrap outermost-first, so the later-registered user-scoped
    # override runs closer to the transport and wins the final header value.
    user_auth_interceptor = user_auth_builder(extensions_config)
    if user_auth_interceptor is not None:
        interceptors.append(user_auth_interceptor)
    ...

​顺序​即​语义​：​先​注册​的​在​洋葱​外层​，​后​注册​的​贴近​传输层​并​最终​决定​ header ​值​， ​所以​优先级​是​ static headers < oauth < user_auth < headers_from_context （mcp/AGENTS.md:56；context_headers.py ​的​拦截器​注册​在​ user_auth ​之后​）。

​自定义​拦截器​在​配置​里​以​ ​模块​:​变量​ ​形式​声明​（extensions_config.example.json:3-5）：

  "mcpInterceptors": [
    "my_package.mcp.auth:build_auth_interceptor"
  ],

​变量​必须​是​无参​ builder，​返回​一个​ async ​拦截器​（​兼容​ MultiServerMCPClient ​的​ tool_interceptors ​接口​）​或​ None。 backend/docs/MCP_SERVER.md:657-673 ​给​了​从​请求​级​ secret ​注入​ Authorization ​的​参考​实现​（​读​运行​时​走​ request.runtime，​不要​用​ langgraph.config.get_config()["context"]——run context ​挂​在​ runtime ​上​， ​不随​ RunnableConfig ​传给​子​ runnable）：

from deerflow.runtime.secret_context import extract_request_secrets


def build_auth_interceptor():
    async def interceptor(request, handler):
        runtime = getattr(request, "runtime", None)
        secrets = extract_request_secrets(getattr(runtime, "context", None))
        token = secrets.get("MCP_AUTH_TOKEN")
        if token:
            request = request.override(
                headers={**(request.headers or {}), "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}
            )
        return await handler(request)

    return interceptor

​生命周期​要点​（MCP_SERVER.md:643-649）：builder ​每​启用​服务器​各跑​一次​， ​不是​每次​发现​跑​一次​；​单台​服务器​的​拦截器​实例​只​观察​该​服务器​的​调用​。​非法​路径​或​ builder ​失败​记​ warning ​跳过​，​不​阻塞​其他​拦截器​。

docs.title: 15.6 ​动手​实验​：​接入​ GitHub MCP server + ​自​建​ stdio MCP server
docs.text: ​两个​实验​共用​一套​前置​：​可​运行​的​ Gateway（make dev）、GITHUB_TOKEN （​实验​ A）​或​离线​环境​（​实验​ B ​用​本地​ Python ​服务器​，​无需​外​网​）。

docs.title: 实验​一​：​接入​ GitHub MCP server
docs.text:
​步骤​ 1：​准备​配置​。 ​把​根目录​ extensions_config.example.json ​复制​为​ extensions_config.json（​若​已​存在​则​跳​过​），​把​ github ​条目​改为​启用​：

    "github": {
      "enabled": true,
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"],
      "env": { "GITHUB_TOKEN": "$GITHUB_TOKEN" },
      "tool_name_prefix": true,
      "session_init_timeout": 60,
      "tool_call_timeout": 60,
      "description": "GitHub MCP server for repository operations"
    }

​并​在​启动​ Gateway ​的​终端​环境​里​导出​ GITHUB_TOKEN（​配置​加载​时​ $GITHUB_TOKEN ​才​会​被​解析​；​未​设置​会​解析​为​空串​，GitHub ​服务器​认证​失败​）。

​步骤​ 2：​重启​ Gateway ​并​验证​发现​。 stdio ​服务器​走​ npx ​拉包​，​首次​启动​ ​可能​逼近​ session_init_timeout（60s）。​观察​ logs/gateway.log：

Configured MCP server: github
...
Using N cached MCP tool(s)

​工具​名​都​带​前缀​：github_create_issue、github_get_me、github_list_issues…

​步骤​ 3：​对话​调用​。 ​在​ http://localhost:2026 ​新建​会话​，​输入​ "​列出​ langchain-ai/langchain ​仓库​里​最新​的​ 5 ​个​ open issue"。​观察​ agent ​选用​ github_list_issues（​或​ github_search_issues）​并​携带​正确​参数​。

​步骤​ 4（​可​选​）：​运行​时热​编辑​。 ​不​重启​，​直接​调​ PATCH /api/mcp/config ​把​ github.enabled ​置​回​ false（​或用​设置​页​的​开关​）， ​再​开新会​话​——github_* ​工具​消失​、​缓存​与​池化会​话​被​退役​；​改​回​ true ​又​回来​。 ​这​就是​ 15.3 ​节双锁​ + ​原子​写​ + ​文件​签名​重​校验​链路​的​直观​体验​。

docs.title: 实验​二​：​自​建​ stdio MCP server ​并​调用
docs.text:
​用​官方​ Python SDK（mcp ​包​，​含​ FastMCP）​写​一个​查询​"​内部​业务​系统​"​的​ stdio ​服务器​。​这里​用​内存​字典​模拟​业务​库​，​完全​离线​可跑​。

​步骤​ 1：​写​服务器​。 ​新建​仓库​外​目录​（​例如​ D:\Code\mcp-demo\server.py）：

"""​内部​业务​系统​查询​ MCP server（stdio ​传输​）。​运行​: python server.py"""
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("internal-biz")

ORDERS = {
    "SO-1001": {"customer": "ACME", "amount": 1299.0, "status": "shipped"},
    "SO-1002": {"customer": "Globex", "amount": 89.0, "status": "pending"},
    "SO-1003": {"customer": "ACME", "amount": 430.0, "status": "cancelled"},
}

@mcp.tool()
def query_order(order_id: str) -> dict:
    """​按​订单号​查询​内部​订单​系统​。​返回​订单​详情​或​ not_found。"""
    return ORDERS.get(order_id, {"status": "not_found"})

@mcp.tool()
def list_orders(customer: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """​列出​订单​，​可​按​客户​名​过滤​。"""
    rows = [{"order_id": k, **v} for k, v in ORDERS.items()]
    return [r for r in rows if customer is None or r["customer"] == customer]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    mcp.run()  # ​默认​ stdio ​传输​

​安装​ SDK：uv pip install mcp（​或​ pip install mcp）。​先​独立​冒烟​测试​： python server.py ​不​报错​即可​（​它​从​ stdin ​读​ MCP ​协议​帧​，Ctrl-C ​退出​）。

​步骤​ 2：​注册​进​ DeerFlow。 ​在​ extensions_config.json ​的​ mcpServers ​下​新增​（command ​用​你​环境​里​能​跑​ python ​的​绝对路径​更稳​）：

    "internal-biz": {
      "enabled": true,
      "type": "stdio",
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["D:/Code/mcp-demo/server.py"],
      "tool_name_prefix": true,
      "session_init_timeout": 30,
      "tool_call_timeout": 30,
      "description": "​内部​业务​系统​订单​查询​"
    }

​注意​：​通过​ API（PUT /api/mcp/config）​提交​这台​服务器时​， _validate_mcp_update_request ​的​ stdio ​白名单​（​默认​只放​ npx/uvx）​会​拒绝​ python——​直接​编辑​本地​ extensions_config.json ​再​重启​，​或​把​ DEER_FLOW_MCP_STDIO_COMMAND_ALLOWLIST ​设​为​ npx,uvx,python ​后​走​ API （​见​ backend/app/gateway/routers/mcp.py:665-694 ​与​ mcp/AGENTS.md:73）。​这​正是​"​配置文件​表达力​ > API ​边界​"​的​现成​例子​。

​步骤​ 3：​重启​ Gateway，​验证​工具​出现​。 ​日志​出现​ Configured MCP server: internal-biz；​新会​话​里​问​ "​查​一下​订单​ SO-1002 ​的​状态​"，agent ​应​调用​ internal-biz_query_order， ​返回​ {"customer": "Globex", "amount": 89.0, "status": "pending"}。 ​再​问​"​列出​ ACME ​的​所有​订单​"​验证​ internal-biz_list_orders。

​步骤​ 4：​观察​ stdio ​会话​隔离​。 ​同一​线程​里​连续​问​两次​查询​——​第二次​不​重启​ ​子​进程​（​会话池​复用​）；​换​一个​新​线程​再查​——​新​线程​拿到​自己​的​会​话​作用域​。 ​可用​ GET /api/mcp/config ​确认​服务器​在​列​；​用​ POST /api/mcp/cache/reset ​强制​重新​发现​，​观察​日志​里​整池​退役​再​重建​。

docs.title: （​进阶​）​长​任务​闭环
docs.text: ​如果​完成​了​两个​基础​实验​，​可​再​走一遍​ long-running-reports ​契约​：​在​ config.yaml ​打开​ mcp_tasks:（enabled: true，​注意​ restart-required ​且​ ​需要​ database.backend: sqlite ​或​ postgres），​为​你​的​ internal-biz ​服务器​ ​加​一个​ task_toolsets（​本地​实现​ submit ​返回​ {"task_id": "R-1", "status": "running"}、get_report_status ​数秒​后​返回​ completed），​然后​： ​对话​中​提交​ → ​拿到​本地​任务​ ID → GET /api/threads/{id}/mcp-tasks/{task_id} ​观察​轮询​ → ​用​ cancel_background_task（​或​ HTTP ​取消​端点​）​走​一次​取消​。 ​这​一段​把​ 15.4 ​节​的​租约​、​通知​与​ 503 ​语义​全部​点亮​。

docs.title: 常见​坑
docs.text:
1. ​改了​配置​不​生效​（​没​重启​/​没​触发​重载​）。​工具​缓存​由​文件​签名​两段式​检查​ ​守护​：(mtime, size, sha256) ​变化​且​"​有效​ MCP ​切片​"​变化​才​退役​ （mcp/AGENTS.md:51）。​只改​ skills ​或​ middlewares ​不​动​ MCP ​服务器时​， ​已​缓存​的​ MCP ​工具​有意​保留​。​而​ mcp_tasks、mcpInterceptors、 task-enabled ​服务器​的​连接​/​超时​改动​是​ startup-only——​必须​重启​ （MCP_SERVER.md:447-453）。​远程​服务器​偷偷​改了​ tools/list ​也​不会​自动​ ​发现​，​用​ POST /api/mcp/cache/reset。
  2. ​把​ $VAR ​写成​混合​字符串​。"Bearer $GITHUB_TOKEN" ​不会​被​展开​——​只有​ ​整串​以​ $ ​开头​才​解析​（MCP_SERVER.md:150-155）。​要么​环境变量​里​放​好​ Bearer <token> ​全值​，​要么​用​拦截器​拼装​。​未​设置​的​变量​解析​为​空串​ （extensions_config.py:584-590），​服务器​会​拿到​空​凭证​而​非​报错​。
  3. ​自己​把​ extensions_config.json ​挂​成​只读​、​或用​单​文件​ bind mount。 ​前者​让​所有​ Gateway ​写​路径​ 500（test_compose_extensions_config_writable.py ​的​存在​就是​防​这个​回归​）；​后者​在​宿主​编辑器​"​保存​替换​文件​"​时​可能​ stale。 Docker ​配置文件​应​放在​目录​ bind mount ​之后​（config/AGENTS.md:120-123）。
  4. ​给​ stdio ​服务器​配​了​ filesystem MCP server。DeerFlow ​自带​线程​工作​区​ ​文件​工具​，​两套​文件​工具​语义​不同​会​让​模型​选择​行为​不​稳​，​且​ DeerFlow ​不​适配​ MCP Roots（MCP_SERVER.md:293-304）。
  5. ​在​拦截器​里​读​ langgraph.config.get_config()["context"]。​工具​调用​里​ ​这个​键​是​ None；run context ​在​ runtime ​上​，​用​ request.runtime （mcp/AGENTS.md:58、MCP_SERVER.md:675-683）。
  6. ​以为​ lease_seconds ​是​远程​调用​超时​。​它​是​崩溃​恢复​窗口​；​远程​调用​的​ ​期限​由​服务器​配置​的​ tool_call_timeout ​控制​（mcp-control-leases.md:3-6）。 ​把​租约​调小想​让​慢​调用​"​早点​失败​"​只会​造成​所有权​抖动​，​正确​做法​是​调​ tool_call_timeout。

docs.title: 下​一步
docs.text: ​你​现在​已经​能​把​任意​外部​系统​工具化​进​ DeerFlow。​下​一章​把​"​不改​核心​"​的​另一半​ ​补齐​：​扩展​（Extensions）​开发​——middleware / lifecycle observers / Gateway services / FastAPI routers / full-stack plugins ​五类​贡献​点​， make extension-install ​生命周期​，​以及​ config.yaml → plugins: ​与​ extensions_config.json ​两条​配置​通道​的​区别​。​见​《​第​ 16 ​章​ ​扩展​（Extensions） ​开发​》（docs/tutorials/16-extensions.md）；​本章​的​ mcpInterceptors ​与​ ​第​ 14 ​章​的​ deerflow_extension_api ​契约​包都​是​它​的​前置​。

docs.title: 16.0 ​学习​目标
docs.text:
​读完​本章​，​你​应该​能够​：

  1. ​复述​ DeerFlow ​的​扩展​优先​哲学​：​新​功能​优先​做成​打包​扩展​而​不是​改​核心​，​核心​只​保留​ bug ​修复​与​ agent loop / ​记忆​ / ​上下文​压缩​ / ​认证​这​类​属于​框架​本身​的​变更​；
  2. ​说出​九大​贡献​点​（middleware、task lifecycle、system-model observer、agent-assembly observer、context-compaction observer、Gateway service、router、full-stack plugin、 knowledge provider）​分别​"​钩​在​宿主​的​哪个​位置​"，​以及​它们​各自​的​注册​方法​名​；
  3. ​读懂​一个​扩展​的​三件套​结构​：PEP 621 ​入口​（deerflow.extensions ​组​）、@extension ​版本​戳​、install(registry, config) ​注册​函数​，​并​能​独立​写出​一个​最小​扩展​；
  4. ​走通​扩展​的​完整​生命周期​：make extension-install → list → enable → restart → ​验证​ → disable → remove，​并​理解​每​一步​在​ pyproject.toml / uv.lock / config.yaml / backend/extensions/sources/ ​里​各改​了​什么​；
  5. ​分清​两条​配置​通道​的​边界​：operator ​专属​的​ config.yaml → plugins:（​会​导入​代码​）​与​ API ​可写​的​ extensions_config.json（middlewares / mcpInterceptors / mcpServers / skills），​以及​为什么​这​条​边界​是​安全​边界​。
